summary: This informational document specifies how TI-LFA mechanisms can be used with Multicast-only Fast Reroute (MoFRR) for PIM. Because TI-LFA precomputes backup paths that avoid failures, it can help multicast streams recover quickly from link or node failures.

eli5.summary: A live video can be sent along a spare route as well, so if one road breaks the picture keeps going. This document explains how to pick good spare routes.
